input.answer:
The job vacancy rate for Canada in August 2026 was 2.8%, meaning about 2.8% of payroll job positions were unfilled. This is the seasonally adjusted figure from StatCan table 14-10-0432 (job vacancy rate, Canada). The rate was also 2.8% in May, June and July 2026.

Calculation: none needed. This is a published level, not a computed change.

Note: the table search card listed the range as ending in 2026-07, but the series lookup returned an August 2026 value, so I used that value. The unadjusted series (table 14-10-0371) is another option if you need non-seasonally-adjusted figures.

answer_values.label: level
answer_values.description: Job vacancy rate, Canada, seasonally adjusted (share of payroll job positions unfilled)
